stories.title: V. D. Satheesan sworn in as Kerala Chief Minister on 18 May 2026
stories.body: the UDF returned to power after a decade, winning 102 of 140 seats, with the Congress alone on 63.

one_liners: V. D. Satheesan sworn in as Kerala Chief Minister on 18 May 2026 — the UDF returned to power after a decade, winning 102 of 140 seats, with the Congress alone on 63.
